name: sqlite-catalog-contracts-history-review
goal: SQLite catalog units declare accurate readable contracts, and history-index source changes retain committed relocation review evidence.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The feature commit adds six SQLite/catalog function manifests with derived contracts, and adds catalog output to two previously moved history modules. Expect every SQLite unit to carry a declared readable contract and each changed moved implementation to retain a review tied to its source commit.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The general contract guard reports gaps but has no targeted catalog contract scenario; the move guard detects stale definitions but does not reject omitting a review while updating the hash. Added targeted SQLite-manifest assertions and a reviewless changed-source regression case.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
